manifest_description: Fit, fill, frame and softly illuminate web video. Entirely local.
controls_ambience_hint: Blur shows a softened video image; Colour follows broad scene colours.
controls_rate_hint: Default balances speed and workload; Performance uses fewer updates; Quality updates fastest.
controls_gesture_tip: Hold $1 + scroll to zoom, drag to pan
popup_mode_hint_both: In-player button where supported, plus a floating popup.
popup_mode_hint_native: Inserted before fullscreen where the player exposes compatible controls.
popup_mode_hint_floating: Reveals within 200px of the video box’s right-center edge. Opens leftward.
popup_netflix_animation_hint: Zoom animations are always disabled on Netflix for stability.
popup_local_pixels: Video pixels are processed only on this device. They are not saved or uploaded.
popup_storage_hint_active: Site preferences override global defaults. Clear site removes site preferences; Clear all resets all saved preferences.
popup_storage_hint_global: Changes save automatically as global defaults.
options_subtitle: Customize global defaults, manage per-site saved framing, configure keyboard shortcuts, and test controls locally.
options_master_toggle_hint: Toggle just_zoom on or off globally across all websites.
options_controls_appearance_hint: Choose how just_zoom controls appear on web video players.
options_gesture_modifier_hint: Hold this modifier while scrolling the wheel to zoom, or click & drag over the video to pan framing.
options_enable_hud: Show on-screen display (HUD) feedback for gestures and shortcuts
options_default_framing_hint: Global default zoom framing when activating zoom on a player.
options_zoom_strategy_auto_hint: Automatic screen framing calculates the exact scale needed to fill your display (e.g. 1.33× on a 21:9 ultrawide) based on screen resolution.
options_ambience_lighting_hint: Softly illuminate the area behind the video with dynamic local backdrops.
options_display_profiles_hint: Adapt automatic framing ratios when viewing on ultrawide, 16:10, or multi-display setups.
options_settings_footer_status: Settings apply automatically to new players.
options_saved_sites_hint: Per-site custom settings override global defaults whenever you visit that site. Click "Save site" inside any video player's popup to add a site here.
options_shortcuts_hint: Click a binding, then press your new shortcut. Changes save globally on this device. Use Alt, Ctrl or Meta with a key; Escape cancels recording. Shortcuts follow physical key positions, ignore typing fields, and work on supported web pages.
options_footer: just_zoom · No accounts, telemetry, uploads or remote configuration.
options_help_fit_fill_text: Fit keeps the entire picture. Fill covers the player. Zoom and pan take manual control; Reset returns to centered Fit.
options_help_remember_text: Changes apply to this player immediately. Save for this site or save as the global default from the controls. Site preferences take priority.
options_help_local_text: All processing is 100% on your device. No user accounts, remote trackers, analytics, video uploads, or subscriptions.
options_experimental_treewalker_desc: Configure how just_zoom scans for video elements nested inside open Shadow DOM roots when no direct document video is detected.
options_experimental_algo_treewalker: TreeWalker (Default · Fast, low memory, pointer-based traversal)
options_experimental_algo_bruteforce: Brute-Force (querySelectorAll · Allocates full DOM node list)
options_experimental_native_workaround_d: Replaces standard browser <video controls> with an unscaled, pixel-faithful Shadow DOM controls bar. This prevents player controls from zooming off-screen at high zoom levels and resolves Chromium fullscreen top-layer occlusion bugs.
options_experimental_native_workaround_e: Enable HTML5 native player controls workaround (Recommended)
options_status_save_failed: Could not save settings. Extension may need to be reloaded.
options_sites_empty_title: No custom site settings saved yet
options_sites_empty_desc: When you open the popup on any video player and click "Save site", its custom settings will appear here.
shortcut_press_prompt: Press a key with $1 for $2. Escape cancels.
shortcut_invalid_prompt: Choose a supported key with Alt, Ctrl or Meta. Escape cancels.
shortcut_load_failed: Using defaults; stored shortcuts could not be read.
shortcut_save_failed: Could not save shortcuts. Try again.
options_lab_hint: Test your settings and shortcuts on live synthetic content. Generic HTML5 native controls are mounted at the bottom right.
options_info_players_hint: The following players have dedicated in-player button integration:
options_info_generic_desc: For generic player frameworks (such as Video.js, Plyr, JW Player, Shaka) and streaming sites without dedicated adapters, just_zoom automatically provides the non-intrusive floating popup button. This ensures zoom and framing controls are always readily accessible without risking layout collisions or breaking custom player toolbars.
options_info_ambience_desc: Ambience currently works on non-DRM protected videos (such as YouTube and standard HTML5 video). Hardware DRM on platforms like Netflix, Disney+, and Prime Video prevents direct frame sampling, so Ambience remains inactive on those streams.
